The '''Shield lense''' was a component that was used in spaceships such as the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. One was added to the ''Falcon'' sometime around [[15 ABY/Legends|15 ABY]].<ref name="BTS">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref>
